## Safety Check

Do not include API keys, tokens, cookies, browser storage state, SSH material,
private hostnames, private IP addresses, private ports, local absolute paths,
production databases, generated reports, or proprietary data. If the issue
requires sensitive details, use private vulnerability reporting instead of a
public issue.
